description: Bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques à Soissons is a dataset listed in GrandSoissons Agglomération open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IRVE. Ce jeu de données présente les données relatives à la localisation géographique et aux caractéristiques techniques des stations et des points de recharge de véhicules électriques ouverts au public. Coverage: Grand Soissons Agglomération. The portal files it under Mobilité, Environnement. Its keywords are Electricité, Mobilité, Consommation. The portal shows 27 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-05-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ville-soissons-fr-portal.
